title: Revolut confirms customer data breach through fake government requests
summary: Revolut, a popular fintech company, confirmed a customer data breach that occurred through social engineering attacks where threat actors impersonated government officials to obtain sensitive customer information via fake legal requests. The breach exposed personal data of customers, highlighting vulnerabilities in how companies verify and process law enforcement requests.
problem_solved: Addresses the growing threat of social engineering attacks targeting financial institutions through fake government/legal requests.
why_valuable: Raises awareness about the importance of robust verification processes for government data requests and the risks of impersonation attacks in the fintech sector.
